facet: Once Human food, drinks and consumable combat buffs, including stacking rules
gameVersionCovered: TW community sheet snapshot imported 2026-05-17 (post Way of Winter / Eternal Dream / Sky Touch / Branch Path; Chefosaurus Rex Azure Melody event Jul 2025), cross-checked against English wiki/guide values from 2024-07..2025. The Oct-2026 live season was not identifiable from reachable sources.

keyClaims.claim: Only one FOOD buff and one DRINK buff can be active at once (eating/drinking another item of the same class overwrites it); food and drink buffs stack with each other. The Chef class 'Glutton' talent raises this to 2 food + 2 drink.
keyClaims.evidence: Steam thread: 'If food buffs take the same buff slot they will overwrite; each of those little circles can hold 1 buff'. Chef Glutton: 'up to 2 food effects and 2 drink effects at the same time'. OHMM 2026 calculator models the loadout as {food, drink}.

keyClaims.claim: Chefosaurus Rex (青龍) territory deviation multiplies the dish's effect value by (1 + bonus): rating 5 = +38% / +31% / +25% (activity >=90 / 20-89 / 0-19); rating 4 = +32/+26/+20%; rating 3 = +26/+21/+15%. E.g. Stargazy Pie 25% -> 34.5% Crit DMG.
keyClaims.evidence: TW Deviations tab row 57 notes (verbatim table) and the food sheet's effect-power column (25->34.5, 20->27.6, 15->20.7, 10->13.8, 30->41.4). OHMM claims a 42% max that is not in the sheet.

keyClaims.claim: Standard combat food/drink buffs last 1800 s (30 min); survival/resist buffs 3600 s; Stardust Tea's Full Stomach 7200 s. Cooking at the Stardust Fusion Stove multiplies buff duration by 1.75 (30 min -> 52.5 min).
keyClaims.evidence: fandom Buffs page: 'Most combat and gathering buffs last 30 minutes, survival buffs run a full hour, Stardust Tea two hours'. TW sheet duration column reads 52.5 for every 30-min buff, 105 for 60-min, 26.25 for 15-min, 17.5 for 10-min.

keyClaims.claim: Shattered Bread (a.k.a. Crumbly Bread) = Weapon DMG +25% for all guns, unconditional; the largest food weapon-damage buff.
keyClaims.evidence: TW sheet: all gun damage +25%; fandom/TheGamer/allthings: 'Weapon DMG +25% for all weapons'. gameleap '+10' is an outlier.

keyClaims.claim: Stargazy Pie = Crit DMG +25% only while the Energy bar is full; Stardust Pumpkin Salad = Crit DMG +15% unconditional; Assorted Canned Fruit = Weakspot DMG +25% only while Sanity > 80%.
keyClaims.evidence: TW sheet rows 5, 7, 14 and fandom/gameplay.tips/sportskeeda quotes with identical numbers and conditions.

keyClaims.claim: Whimsical Drink (drink slot) = Status DMG +25%; the sheet-only 'Signature Beverage' (異想天開飲) = Weapon DMG +10%, so a drink can add gun damage on top of a food buff.
keyClaims.evidence: TW sheet rows 61-62; fandom Whimsical Drink: '+25% status damage for 30 minutes'.
keyClaims.confidence: high (Whimsical) / medium (Signature Beverage; EN name unverified)

keyClaims.claim: Targeted damage foods: Bone-In Deviated Sausage +15% vs bosses; Mixed Fried Hot Dog +20% vs targets under The Bull's Eye; Honey Glazed Meat +15% Crit Rate vs enemies in Frost Vortex; French Fries +20% Weapon DMG inside Fortress Warfare; Roulette Dumplings random +15% vs elites/bosses/Deviants (all three under Moon Omen).
keyClaims.evidence: TW sheet rows 8, 10, 11, 18, 23 agree with fandom Buffs and Effects quotes.

keyClaims.claim: Element/status-specific foods: Canned Meat (Canned Steak) Shrapnel +20% (fandom: +10%), Ginger Poppers Shrapnel +10%, Hearty Meat Stew Blaze +15%, Canned Minty Meat Frost +15%, Canned Spicy Rabbit Dices Blaze +15% (ambient >30 C), Popcorn Unstable Bomber +10%, Flaming Eggtart Burn +10%, Sparkling Pumpkin Soup (drink) Power Surge +10%, Layered Galaxy Elemental +30% airborne (discontinued).
keyClaims.evidence: TW sheet effect texts; fandom confirms Ginger Poppers 10% and Sparkling Pumpkin Soup 10%.

keyClaims.claim: Shellfish Meat applies a 5% Vulnerability (damage-taken increase) to any enemy you hit for 10 s, non-stacking: a food-sourced target debuff multiplicative with the player's own buffs.
keyClaims.evidence: TW sheet row 40 (on hit, apply 5% vulnerability to the target for 10 s, cannot stack).

keyClaims.claim: Generic-ingredient dishes add a small ingredient sub-buff: Canned Lunch Meat (Max HP +10%) gains +2% Shrapnel/Melee/Frost Vortex/Power Surge/Bull's-Eye/Burn/Unstable Bomber/Bounce DMG depending on Bear/Beast/Beef/Crocodile/Deer/Goat/Pork/Poultry meat; the sheet marks 16 dishes as taking a meat sub-effect.
keyClaims.evidence: fandom Canned Lunch Meat table; TW sheet ingredient-effect column.
keyClaims.confidence: medium (Canned Lunch Meat) / low (other dishes' values)

keyClaims.claim: Defensive consumables: Safety Sandwich -20% damage taken from players (PvP only); Seafood and Meat Platter Max HP +15% plus full heal over 30 s; Butter Matsutake -8% status damage taken (-12% when fed and hydrated); Miracle Tea (drink) +10% to all healing.
keyClaims.evidence: TW sheet rows 21, 26, 32, 76; fandom: 'Safety Sandwich: Reduce DMG from other players by 20%'; charlieintel: 'Miracle Tea: Healing Effect +10'.
